Given a tracial C*-algebra carrying a MeasurementAlgebraStructure (the game measurement algebra ∗ⁿ (Fin m → ℂ), citation-provided by the MIP*=RE/KPS construction), free-product permanence of the lifting property (Boca — the sole deep gap), and no u.c.p.-amenable microstates (the MIP*=RE qa≠qc separation), the trace is not Connes-embeddable. Everything here is kernel-trio; the single-citation distance is now exactly the one theorem BocaFreeProductPermanence.
